gloss: to lean forward, to embark on

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {乗|の}り{出|だ}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {乗|の}り{出|だ}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {乗|の}り{出|だ}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: To move the upper body forward, showing interest or eagerness.

definitions.gloss: to embark on, to venture into
definitions.explanation: To start participating in or launching into a new activity or field.

examples.english: I leaned forward and listened to the story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}して⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The spectators were leaning forward watching the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To venture into a new business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The government has embarked on countermeasures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}す⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The company decided to venture into overseas markets.

notes:
{乗|の}り{出|だ}す is a compound verb with two main meanings: physically leaning forward, or figuratively embarking on something.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to start/put out)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}す: to lean forward (showing interest)
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}す: to venture into a business
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{出|だ}す: to take action on measures

USAGE:
Sense 2 (embark on) often implies taking initiative or actively getting involved in something new.
